title: Tiers list shows number, name, customers, matrices and status
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps: 1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Each row shows a number, a name, a Customers count and a status.
  • Each row also shows a Matrices value.
  • The numbers sit under a # header, as plain text, with no pill or badge.
  • Default is number 1.
  • Tier A is the last active row, with the highest number.
